event: Nothing Happened
trigger: Trigger unconfirmed
trigger_source: Terrain, actors, and native A-button routine in the A4NP ROM
trigger_evidence: This script displays a no-effect interaction message. The entry point for this precise version remains to be established. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts/eu/EventScript_LocationInteraction_ShowNothingHappenedMessage.mary.c#L6-L17 The five identifiers examined (0003, 0158, 0181, 0340, 0544) exist in all four editions. None of the 4 628 calls and assignments from regional sources targets these scripts. The base maps and field corrections A4NP (214 667 boxes examined) do not contain any of these identifiers. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/tree/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts In the A4NP routine of interaction with A (0x02E110–0x02EC0A), the four fixed identifiers are 0008, 0009, 0013 and 0973. The combination of keys in this routine launches 0974. Other identifiers come from the field or from the actor method at 0x02E7C4. The 55 virtual tables of identified actors give five methods for this call. The 35 calls to the NPC manufacturer, the eight calls to the constructor of the errant actors and the table of the seven luteins do not select any of the five scripts sought. RIFF A4NP (0x03EF00), 0x2AC200 block, 0x0F8A2C box. The only pointer to this block is in its main table box. The 696 script calls and 459 actor assignments in 1 328 blocks CODE A4NP have been verified. All of them have a solved ID and none of them are targeting this block. The two paths specific to the tutorial remain in the 1059 scripts to 1063. The identified native file paths 43 and the verified fields and corrections 214 667 do not select this script.

It is on the ground in the plans 42 and 43. The destination box has a zero displacement ID on all three planes. The farm exit uses 0358, row 27. The positions are in pixels. RIFF A4NP (0x03EF00), 0x2C7CA8 block, 0x0F8BDC box. The only pointer to this block is in its main table box. The 696 script calls and 459 actor assignments in 1 328 blocks CODE A4NP have been verified. All of them have a solved ID and none of them are targeting this block. The two paths specific to the tutorial remain in the 1059 scripts to 1063. The identified native file paths 43 and the verified fields and corrections 214 667 do not select this script.

event: Cliff Collapses
trigger: Enter Rose Square from the south between 10 a.m. and 2:59 p.m. on a snowy day from Winter 1 to 26 of Year 1. You must have met Cliff, have at least 50 friendship points with him, and be empty-handed. Ann must be unmarried, Ann and Cliff’s rival marriage must be in its initial state, and this must be the first time Cliff collapses. You receive the photo during the scene and can return it at Cliff’s bed through script 0229.

trigger_evidence: 0527 launches 0781 to 0x32C687. 0781 gives the photo to 0x3692FE, finishes the malaise at 0x36976A and starts the recovery at 0x369774. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts/eu/EventScript_LocationTransition_EnterRoseSquareWithFestivalAndCharacterEventDispatch.mary.c#L208-L213

event: Cliff's Photo
trigger: Trigger unconfirmed
trigger_source: A4NP bytecode and native selection of Cliff’s schedule
trigger_status: Entry point unconfirmed · alternate photo scene identified
trigger_evidence: This variant directly initiates the dialogue, finishes the follow-up to 0x3699C3 and adds 20 friendship points to 0x3699CC. The path checked to make the photo is the interaction 0229. The 0782 to 0x369938 block is referenced by its 0x0F9658 box in the main table. Script calls, character assignments and field tables examined do not refer to 0782. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts/eu/EventScript_NPCEvent_Cliff_CollapsesInSnow_CliffPhoto_FollowupCliffDialogue.mary.c#L35-L55 The Cliff manufacturer provides the 0996 conversation script to 0x036756–0x03675A. The routine that chooses Cliff's place of recovery changes his position and animation. His dialogue choice continues to go through 0996 or an explicit assignment, via 0x034EF4. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/src/npc_entity.cc#L5623-L5627 https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/src/npc_entity.cc#L5669-L5684 RIFF A4NP (0x03EF00), 0x369938 block, 0x0F9658 box. The only pointer to this block is in its main table box. The 696 script calls and 459 actor assignments in 1 328 blocks CODE A4NP have been verified. All of them have a solved ID and none of them are targeting this block. The two paths specific to the tutorial remain in the 1059 scripts to 1063. The identified native file paths 43 and the verified fields and corrections 214 667 do not select this script. The native manufacturer gives Cliff the default 0996 dialog. The recovery route places him at the clinic, where the bed attribute selects 0229. The 0782.01 and 0782.03 replicas are identical to 0996.11 and 0996.13 respectively. mGBA test on a state copy where Cliff's date, weather and convalescence and encounter conditions were set, photo in hand. After entering the door, A from the north and from the west of the bed opens 0229 (CODE 0x082D2D40). The dialog removes the photo, goes from 50 to 70 points of friendship in the completed trial and maintains the active recovery.

event: Debug Menu
trigger: Trigger unconfirmed
trigger_source: Regional comparison, A4NP loaders, and forced loading in mGBA 0.10.5
trigger_status: Entry point unconfirmed · debug menu identified
trigger_evidence: The diagnostic menu edits the affinities. The analysis of 1 328 blocks CODE of the game solved the 696 direct script calls and 459 script assignments to the characters. None of these paths targets 1031. Possible native access remains to be established. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts/eu/EventScript_DebugEvent_CharacterAffectionEditor.mary.c The menu is present in the four editions examined. In A4NP, the only pointer to this block appears in its main table box. The two additional native references to the table belong to the tutorial engine. Its input table at 0x0F19FA contains 1059 and 1063. Inserting a 1031 request in the RAM script file, in a mGBA status copy, opens the menu and its choices. This manipulation confirms the contents of the script. The original action of the farm calendar is 0345 on the field A4NP verified. https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/tree/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts The A4NP main charger, 0x03F88C, receives its bytecode, event queue or stage launch code identifier. In this last path, the only fixed call identified is the introduction 0867 to 0x0D89CE. The 1031 menu leads by "Surprise 1" to the procession of the Goddess and the Lutins (0424), and by "Surprise 2" to the purchase tutorial (0423). https://github.com/Wokann/fomt/blob/9f2f03c775d64270a95250b8c03e6742219fda21/data/scripts/eu/EventScript_DebugEvent_CharacterAffectionEditor.mary.c#L2016-L2023 RIFF A4NP (0x03EF00), 0x40CA10 block, 0x0F9A3C box. The only pointer to this block is in its main table box. The 696 script calls and 459 actor assignments in 1 328 blocks CODE A4NP have been verified. All of them have a solved ID and none of them are targeting this block. The two paths specific to the tutorial remain in the 1059 scripts to 1063. The identified native file paths 43 and the verified fields and corrections 214 667 do not select this script. Scene launchers, hardware shortcut routine and GameCube link examined do not select 1031. The request for script added to RAM is only used to verify the content.
